scenes.label: Farraki sandstone audience court
scenes.facts: An open sandstone audience court, with broad worn steps, a raised stone seat, square carved pylons, woven sunshades, pottery and muted red cloth. Barren sand and rocky ridges lie beyond its walls.
scenes.purpose: A place for an audience or discussion; an active ceremony is not implied.
scenes.socialContext: The sandstone court gives the settlement's chiefly business an open, commanding place. A visitor can establish a purpose at the broad approach before presenting a message, valued object or claim at the audience platform. Carved stone, stored possessions and household craft give lineage, service, supplies and protected access tangible subjects. The open floor permits a witnessed agreement when others are present; side recesses allow quieter terms. Arid surroundings can matter to the practical conversation, while the participants decide its urgency, tone and significance. This venue does not establish a priesthood or active rite.

scenes.label: Kaldorei forest gathering lodge
scenes.facts: An open-sided Kaldorei lodge with sweeping curved timber ribs, organic carvings, violet-blue cloth, low curved benches and ceramic cups at a rear serving ledge. Immense old trees, layered ferns and softly luminous blue-violet flowers surround the lodge. Warm lantern pools soften the forest's cool twilight palette.
scenes.purpose: A gathering and rest space with refreshments; no religious ceremony or automatic drunkenness.

scenes.label: Dwarven ale hall
scenes.facts: Low massive stone vaults, squared granite piers with angular carvings, iron-braced beams, copper brewing vessels and oak ale barrels. Stout tables and benches flank a clear floor; a recessed hearth and lanterns cast warm light.
scenes.purpose: Hospitality, brewing and conversation; drinking is available rather than compulsory.

scenes.label: Human roadside inn
scenes.facts: A timber-and-stone inn with candle chandeliers, a wooden serving counter, casks, bottles and plain tables and benches.
scenes.purpose: A familiar place for rest, refreshment and local conversation; no occupants or affiliation are asserted.

scenes.label: Ashenvale woodland gathering place
scenes.facts: A deeply shaded ancient woodland with towering trees, violet foliage, softly luminous leaves and a small stream. Curving Kaldorei roofs and restrained lantern lights sit among the trees.
scenes.purpose: A woodland meeting beside local Kaldorei structures; no spirit encounter or active spell is asserted.

scenes.label: Naga imperial audience hall
scenes.facts: An enclosed Naga audience hall of vaulted violet stone, fin-shaped columns and curling galleries edged in gold, turquoise enamel and pearl. A broad coiling dais sits beyond a broad dry polished approach. Contained side pools reflect blue-green light across cultivated coral ornament, jeweled vessels and violet hangings.
scenes.purpose: A formal audience space with broad circulation for serpentine bodies and dry approaches for visitors. Its marine craftsmanship does not imply that the province or the room is underwater.
scenes.socialContext: An approach through marine splendour makes differences of rank and access tangible. There is room to announce a visitor, present tribute or correspondence, and address the presiding station without entering its privileged space. Military reports, maritime claims and lavish hospitality fit this imperial household. Its side galleries offer a less exposed setting for negotiation than the broad audience floor. Permission to approach a jeweled object or use a particular resting place can carry social meaning; how anyone responds to that distinction belongs to the participants.

scenes.label: Goblin cartel audience headquarters
scenes.facts: A Goblin executive court builds an extravagant little red-and-gold seat into a colossal gilded vault assembly crowned by a grinning carved Goblin face. Huge pressure pipes, gauges, cranes and mechanical safes compete with coin heaps, sample crates and green alchemical glass. Counting tables, locked stores and hazard-striped fittings frame the clear audience floor beneath blue and amber lamps.
scenes.purpose: A commercial audience and negotiation space with Goblin-sized controls and a broad visitor floor. Its possessions provide opportunities for interaction without dictating a character's motives.
scenes.socialContext: Court business and commercial spectacle share the same extravagant headquarters. An offer, contract, sample or improbably useful invention can become the centre of an audience, with counting surfaces and conspicuous acquisitions close at hand. Who gets attention, access to a safe, or a place at the executive station can be as consequential as the terms being discussed. Machinery and competing displays give the space an energetic, occasionally inconvenient texture; side counting bays allow more discreet bargaining. The surroundings invite negotiation and showmanship without making every occupant greedy or reckless.

scenes.label: Solsticean carved timber court
scenes.facts: A tall human timber court with carved beast-ended beams, stout grey-stone footings and layered woven hangings. A deeply carved high seat stands above broad benches and a council table. Ancestral shields, drinking horns, document chests and substantial iron lamps line the side bays; amber hearthlight reveals vigorous woodwork and warm wool.
scenes.purpose: An audience and deliberation space. These surroundings provide opportunities for interaction; they do not prescribe the current ruler's personality, faith, allegiance or conduct.
scenes.socialContext: A substantial household hall joins lordly business to shared hospitality. Benches and council tables give arrivals places to wait, examine a letter or lay out a claim; the high seat distinguishes formal address from conversation at the tables. Ancestral arms lend weight to questions of service, ownership and remembered obligations. Voices can carry across the open room, while the furnished side bays offer a more discreet exchange. A petition may become a communal matter when witnesses are present, or remain a quiet meeting within the same hall.

scenes.label: Arathorian royal audience hall
scenes.facts: A martial human royal hall of pale dressed stone, thick arches and deep window embrasures. A high-backed oak seat beneath a blue-and-gold carved canopy faces patterned paving. Lion reliefs, ancestral arms, layered tapestries, charter cabinets and a map table give the fortress court an inhabited dignity; daylight and candles warm the masonry.
scenes.purpose: An audience and deliberation space. These surroundings provide opportunities for interaction; they do not prescribe the current ruler's personality, faith, allegiance or conduct.
scenes.socialContext: This is a noble household conducting the practical business of rule. The clear approach supports introductions and the presentation of letters, claims or gifts before the high seat. Arms, charter storage and the map table make lineage, defended territory and recorded obligations tangible subjects for discussion. Service furnishings allow hospitality without automatically convening a feast. The broad central floor lends a formal address visibility; side tables and deep stone bays support quieter counsel. Admission, seating and permission to handle an heirloom offer small but meaningful points of etiquette.

scenes.label: Gilnean aristocratic audience manor
scenes.facts: A dark aristocratic human manor court with tall leaded windows, paneled timber, wrought-iron galleries and a substantial marble hearth. A richly upholstered authority seat sits beneath carved oak framing. Heavy plum drapery, silver lamps, hunting trophies, archival cabinets and elegant service tables lend depth to the guarded chamber.
scenes.purpose: An audience and deliberation space. These surroundings provide opportunities for interaction; they do not prescribe the current ruler's personality, faith, allegiance or conduct.
scenes.socialContext: Household hospitality and official access overlap in this carefully furnished manor. An introduction, a seat near the hearth or an invitation farther into the room can mark different degrees of familiarity. Hunting possessions and archival cabinets connect family standing to practical estate business: letters, inherited property, service and obligations. The great room can receive a formal petition, while curtains and recessed furnishings allow a less exposed conversation. Its elegance gives courtesy and reputation a setting in which to matter without requiring an aloof or suspicious host.

scenes.label: Southern trading audience pavilion
scenes.facts: A handsome human trading court beneath ribbed timber and layered woven canopies. Carved travel chests, cargo samples, route maps, brass instruments and a guarded counting table surround a richly cushioned captain-chief's seat. Ropework, dyed awnings, patterned rugs and warm lanterns turn portable possessions into an established audience household.
scenes.purpose: An audience and deliberation space. These surroundings provide opportunities for interaction; they do not prescribe the current ruler's personality, faith, allegiance or conduct.
scenes.socialContext: Portable wealth has been arranged into a substantial audience household. Travel chests, route materials and goods make supplies, passage, cargo claims and promised service natural business here. A visitor can present credentials or an object at the counting table before approaching the cushioned presiding station. Shared tables suit hospitality and negotiation; layered fabrics offer degrees of privacy without the separation of stone corridors. The organisation suggests a household accustomed to moving valuable possessions, but neither the building nor the encounter requires a journey or a particular faction.

scenes.label: Orcish clan command great hall
scenes.facts: An immense Orcish clan hall of thick timber posts, heavy cross-braces, iron bands and stretched hide. Tusks and horn-shaped brackets crown the entrance to a broad hide-covered command seat. Clan-pattern textiles, trophy arms, drums, substantial vessels and a war table fill side bays; firelight glances across smoke-dark wood, bone and charcoal iron.
scenes.purpose: An audience and deliberation space. These surroundings provide opportunities for interaction; they do not prescribe the current ruler's personality, faith, allegiance or conduct.
scenes.socialContext: Clan government shares the great hall with counsel, hospitality and the handling of martial equipment. A visitor's purpose can be announced from the open approach; a weapon, trophy or remembered service may give a claim a tangible history. Heavy tables support agreements and practical planning beneath the chief's station. Speech across the main floor is exposed to anyone actually present, while hide-screened bays allow more private discussion. Approaching a treasured object or entering the household's inner space can require permission. This setting supports honour, disagreement and reconciliation in the characters' own terms.

scenes.label: Gorian ogre imperial audience court
scenes.facts: An Ogre court of colossal dressed-stone arches, immense terraces and heavy geometric carving. A vast throne platform with a broad resting seat rises behind low wide stairs. Giant bronze vessels, elaborate red textiles, enormous weapon rests and stacked tribute chests show an imperial household built for immense bodies, with smaller visitor routes beside its commanding approach.

scenes.socialContext: Imperial household business is conducted at an overwhelming physical scale. The broad approach makes the distance to the presiding platform conspicuous, while smaller visitor positions allow an envoy to be heard without climbing onto the ruler's resting place. Tribute vessels and substantial stores lend weight to supplies, service, ownership and negotiated rank. The chamber can accommodate witnessed petitions or council business; its side stations allow more direct exchanges over an object or a document. Immense fittings express institutional wealth rather than establishing any occupant's intelligence, appetite or number of heads.

scenes.label: Vrykul ancestral high-seat hall
scenes.facts: A giant-scale Vrykul court carries immense timber rafters over monumental grey-stone piers. Deep runic borders, beast-ended beams and heavy iron doors frame a shield-backed high seat. Enormous benches, drinking horns, carved memorial panels, woven cloth and well-maintained weapons give heroic ancestral weight to the amber-lit hall.
scenes.purpose: An audience and deliberation space. These surroundings provide opportunities for interaction; they do not prescribe the current ruler's personality, faith, allegiance or conduct.
scenes.socialContext: The great hall accommodates formal rule, martial counsel and household hospitality at giant scale. Broad tables allow goods or evidence to be presented before a more ceremonial approach to the high seat. Recognition, arbitration or an oath can have public weight if witnesses are present; side bays provide a less conspicuous setting for counsel. Seating and access distinguish degrees of standing, while the particular ruler and guests decide what those distinctions mean.

scenes.label: Mogu imperial authority palace
scenes.facts: Colossal Mogu face reliefs and immense jade-dark square piers dominate an imperial audience court. Giant carved lion-like quilen, red lacquer bands and curling gold borders surround the long ceremonial approach. A monumental dynastic relief wall backs the raised stone station; bronze vessels and inert ranked stone figures give the enormous terraces forceful ochre, jade and vermilion richness.

The central floor exposes a formal exchange to witnesses when present; the massive side bays permit closer consultation. Sculptural guardians lend authority to the architecture. Their presence does not establish living guards, current conquest or compulsory deference by the characters.

A richly cushioned little council seat is surrounded by route records, scales, counting boards and protected goods. Luckydos, charms, fragrant bundles, panniers, yak bells and extraordinary keepsakes fill orderly side stores; broad cargo passages contrast with small furnishings.

Shared counters make an agreement visible when others are present; sheltered stores offer quieter terms. scenes.label: Saurok warband stronghold court
scenes.facts: A Saurok audience stronghold fits rugged rock and seized imperial masonry with thick lashed timber, hide screens and stout barricades. A broad backless command seat rests on a raised stone ledge. Spear racks, shields, captured carved vessels, secured stores and trophies line the sides; smoky orange light reveals worn grey stone, dark wood and bold cloth.

Weapons and captured craftsmanship can serve as evidence in claims over service, territory, supplies or standing. The backless station and broad passages make the audience usable for tailed bodies without dictating a posture. Open assembly space lends a dispute visibility; hide partitions and side stores permit more guarded negotiation. Martial surroundings provide opportunities for caution or confidence without forcing aggression.

scenes.label: Pandaren cultivated audience pavilion
scenes.facts: A refined Pandaren court combines polished red-brown timber, elaborate bracket beams, cream plaster and rounded lattice doorways. Jade-green borders and cloud-pattern carving enrich a broad crafted audience seat. Scroll cabinets, maintained weapons, glazed ceramics, tea tables, generous cushions and lantern-lit side alcoves provide learned hospitality around a clear formal floor.
scenes.purpose: An audience and deliberation space. These surroundings provide opportunities for interaction; they do not prescribe the current ruler's personality, faith, allegiance or conduct.
scenes.socialContext: Tea furnishings, scholarly possessions and maintained arms bring hospitality, learning and practical government into the same room. A visitor can settle at a side table, present a letter or object, then approach the formal station when the meeting calls for it. Petitions, mediation, instruction and discussion of service fit this cultivated household. Public address has a clear central space, while screens and furnished alcoves support private counsel. Excellent workmanship gives gifts and courteous gestures material significance; it does not require the participants to be patient, convivial or ceremonious.

scenes.label: Jinyu water-forged audience hall
scenes.facts: A Jinyu court is worked in smoothly sculpted grey stone, layered finlike portals and carved current bands. Teal inlay and restrained gilding edge an enduring authority platform. Carefully bounded pools and consultation basins reflect blue-green light; orderly records, crafted arms and ceremonial vessels sit beneath generous clearances for tall finned heads.

A designated speaking position distinguishes a formal introduction from movement through the court's working space. Maintained arms, records and aquatic craftsmanship give claims over waters, passage, provisions and communal obligations tangible subjects. Consultation basins and side stations allow an object or proposal to be examined more closely than on the open audience floor. The setting accommodates counsel and negotiation without establishing a ritual, prophetic reading or a particular relationship to the sea outside this room.

scenes.label: Hozen chief's elevated audience lodge
scenes.facts: A Hozen chiefly hall is built from irregular heavy poles, coarse woven walls and thick rope lashings. Strong crossbeams connect perches, side platforms and hanging storage around a high trophy-framed command seat. Drums, bright cloth, captured valuables, food vessels and bundled arms enliven the rough timber; a clear lower approach serves visitors who do not climb.

Climbing routes and upper platforms make movement unusually visible, while the lower approach allows guests to speak without climbing. A useful gift, recovered object or claim of service can focus an audience; food stores and bundled equipment connect chiefly business to practical communal needs. Drums and trophy displays suit recognition or competitive presentation when participants choose it. Side shelters offer some discretion, although the open vertical layout can carry voices and expose attention. It need not turn every conversation into boasting or a challenge.

Turquoise, ochre gold, crimson and violet enrich the chiefly station and its immense relief wall. Heirloom arms, bronze vessels, vivid textiles and protected chests occupy deep carved recesses beside a broad open gathering approach.

Drums, masks and heirlooms offer a material vocabulary for lineage, service and the history of a gift. The broad terraces accommodate formal address and witnesses when present; deep side recesses allow quieter bargaining or reconciliation. Household resources and protected possessions remain close to government. The carving does not determine the court's current faith or require a priestly ceremony.

scenes.label: Gilblin treasure-chief audience hall
scenes.facts: A Gilblin court arranges shell-framed stone, weathered ship timber and coral-encrusted salvage into a rich treasure household. A great shell seat overlooks a broad dry ledge. Anchors, unfamiliar machine parts, polished stones, nets, bottles and prized vessels fill guarded niches; pearl surfaces and blue-green reflections contrast with rusty iron and warm lamps.

The open floor makes dealings visible to anyone present, while sheltered salvage niches allow more discreet terms. A treasured machine part or shell can matter for reasons beyond its price.

scenes.label: Dwarven masterwork royal audience hall
scenes.facts: A monumental Dwarven court of enormous squared granite blocks and deep arches rises above stout low furnishings. Bronze borders, angular runic bands and carved bearded stone faces frame a finely fitted clan throne. Masterwork arms, ancestral record chests, gemstones and ceremonial vessels line side recesses beneath warm hanging lamps and iron braziers.
scenes.purpose: An audience and deliberation space. These surroundings provide opportunities for interaction; they do not prescribe the current ruler's personality, faith, allegiance or conduct.
scenes.socialContext: A petition enters a setting of clan memory and conspicuous workmanship. Letters, family claims, rights of ownership and questions of service can acquire weight through an heirloom or a carefully examined piece of craft. Broad central space permits public recognition when witnesses are present; deep stone bays support quieter counsel. Permission to handle a masterwork or consult a protected record can provide a natural point of negotiation.

scenes.label: Gnomish tinkers' civic audience court
scenes.facts: A Gnomish civic court surrounds a small adjustable seat with colossal rounded red-and-blue mechanical housings, concentric gears and towering blue electrical coils. Brass catwalks connect upper stations; compact controls, prototype tables and precise glass instruments contrast with the enormous engineered structure. A broad circular demonstration floor glints beneath amber lamps and cool contained electrical light.

The demonstration floor permits an explanation to become visible; side workstations offer closer examination and more selective consultation. Ownership, credit, access to an instrument and responsibility for a device's costs are natural subjects. Mechanisms and displays give the room lively practical interruptions without requiring an accident, brilliant discovery or any particular temperament from its occupants.

scenes.facts: Immense living trunks and sweeping timber arches form a Kaldorei audience bower around moon-silver stone terraces. Monumental carved owls frame an elegant leaf-shaped station beneath layered violet banners. Glaive displays, shallow managed water, flowers and organic galleries combine mythic blue-violet shade with silver and amber lamps; a clear patterned approach leads to the audience platform.

The open approach gives a formal address visibility; sheltered bough galleries allow more private reconciliation or planning. Enduring possessions can connect present business to long memory. This court's craft does not establish a religious observance, a moonwell or the state of the surrounding forest.

scenes.label: Highborne arcane aristocratic court
scenes.facts: A Highborne court of lavender-grey stone has curved galleries, sweeping stairs and elaborate bronze-bordered colonnades. Deep indigo and wine-purple fabrics enrich a gracefully flared audience seat. Mounted arcane crystals, suspended lamps, astrolabes, scholarly cabinets, exquisite goblets and ornamental plants give the cultivated palace precise magical comfort.

The formal floor supports witnessed petitions; side tables and curved galleries permit quieter conversation. Hospitality can be generous or competitive according to the participants. The instruments do not grant their users new powers or establish an active magical experiment.

scenes.label: Cape of Stranglethorn: Palm-fringed sandy shore

Wind and distant surf share the air, making softer voices easier to hear behind the shoulder than at the edge. A low hollow offers a little protection, while the surrounding mountain shoulders keep the wider country out of sight.

scenes.facts: The higher shelf alternates between bare grey stone and snow-filled seams. A rounded shoulder interrupts the wind, with the thickest drifts gathered on its sheltered side. The outer edge opens a wide view above the trees, while the inner ground remains close to the rock. Footsteps sound sharply on exposed stone and soften on the snow. The shelf gives room to stand together, though its narrower margins lead toward steeper broken ground.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Badlands: Ochre dry country
scenes.facts: Cracked earth opens between the low stones and thorny plants. The mesas remain visible across the dry country, giving the exposed ground a long horizon. Dust gathers in shallow washes and moves readily when disturbed. A larger outcrop shades part of the foreground, where the air is less exposed to the sun. There is little cover in the open center. The contrast between shade, loose dust and harder crust shapes where people can comfortably pause together.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Badlands: Red canyon ground
scenes.facts: The canyon shortens the horizon to the next bend. Sand and gravel collect between harder shelves, while a recess gives deeper shade beside the open floor. Thorny plants occupy the few seams that hold enough soil. Voices meet the nearby rock and return in a brief uneven echo. The upper faces catch more light than the sheltered ground below. A broad shelf provides a place to stop apart from the looser footing in the lower hollow.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Searing Gorge: Volcanic gorge uplands
scenes.facts: Dark stone alternates with shallow patches of pale dust. A low fin shields part of the open ground, while the chasm beyond breaks the wider view into opposite slopes and shadowed depth. Sparse stems move where soil has gathered in the seams. Footsteps sound sharp on the rock and softer in the ash. The air is dry and mineral-heavy. The inner shelf offers more sheltered space than the exposed face overlooking the cut ground.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Searing Gorge: Deep volcanic rock cut
scenes.facts: The cut holds shade beneath high dark faces. Ash gathers around the larger boulders, leaving the central shelf harder and more exposed. The nearest stone blocks part of the view into the deeper hollow. Voices return briefly from the walls, while loose grit makes a sharper sound as it shifts on the ledges. Mineral-colored seams run through the rock. The clear patch provides room to stop, with smaller sheltered spaces beside the heavier stone.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Wetlands: Broad delta marsh
scenes.facts: The channels divide the marsh into irregular grassy patches. A firmer tussock rises above the wet edge, while reeds conceal smaller pools nearby. The distant mountain rim remains visible beyond the mist, giving the low ground a strong enclosing boundary. Water and stems make soft continuous sounds close by. Damp air smells of mud and fresh vegetation. The open horizon allows longer views above the reeds, though the lower ground stays hidden between them.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Wetlands: Estuary shore
scenes.facts: The estuary gives a wider view beyond the reeds. The upper margin stays firmer than the muddy shallows, where small channels meet the tidal water. Washed stones and driftwood mark the reach of earlier surf. Salt mixes with the marsh smell, and open water carries a broader sound than the narrow inland channels. The higher bank offers room to pause with the shore in view, while reeds and spreading trees shelter its inland side.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Loch Modan: Pine basin woods
scenes.facts: Pine roots cross the ground between rounded grey stones. The canopy shelters a small level patch and opens briefly toward the greener basin below. Needles make a softer layer underfoot than the exposed rock, while moss marks the dampest shaded seams. Resin scents the close air. The trees shorten sightlines along the slope, with the mountain shoulders visible higher through the branches. The open patch gives room to pause apart from the denser growth immediately around it.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Northeron uplands: Heavy ironwood country
scenes.facts: Heavy ironwood trunks stand close above roots that grip the stony slope. Water darkens the bark and gathers in mossy hollows below the firmer root banks. The air smells of wet wood and mountain stone. Dense crowns soften the wind, though gusts make the whole canopy shift with a low, deep sound. Nearby trunks hide the lower slope; gaps reveal gray ridges farther away. Raised roots offer shelter and firmer footing where the soil becomes soft between the rocks.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Northeron uplands: Storm-exposed highlands
scenes.facts: Rough grass covers the shoulder below dark, imposing peaks. Gray crags break the slopes into open shelves and abrupt hollows, with trees gathering where the wind loses its force. Cloud shadows move quickly across the country. The exposed heights reveal distant movement until weather closes the view; lower folds conceal anything close to the ridge. Wet stone demands care underfoot. Wind presses speech flat in the open, but a recessed shelf offers enough quiet to hear voices over the grasses.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Northeron uplands: Rugged highland coastal faces
scenes.facts: Steep headlands enclose a rough shore of gray boulders and dark wet shelves. The sea strikes between them with a deep, repeated crash, sending salt into the wind. Grass and hardy trees gather above the tide in protected folds. The open faces give clear views along the coast, while each cove disappears behind its enclosing rock. Lower stone is slick and uneven. A higher recess cuts the wind, though the surf still makes softer speech difficult to distinguish.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: The Far Highlands: Green highland woodland pockets
scenes.facts: Green trees fill the hollow beneath great gray rock faces. Roots and grass cover the firmer shelves, while moss gathers where water seeps between the stones. The air carries resin and damp mineral scents. Dense trunks hide the lower ground, but the rocky opening gives a clear view toward the neighboring heights. Footsteps soften among needles and become sharp on exposed stone. The enclosing cliffs return louder sounds faintly, while closer conversation stays beneath the moving branches.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: The Far Highlands: Broad rough ridge country
scenes.facts: Coarse grass runs between gray crags along the broad ridge. Trees gather in sheltered folds, leaving the higher shoulders open to the wind. The view crosses neighboring heights and darker wooded pockets, but the ground falls away sharply beyond each crest. Loose stone scrapes underfoot beside firmer turf. The air smells of grass and cool mineral dust. Outcrops provide a quieter lee where words remain clear, while voices scatter across the exposed shoulder when the wind rises.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: The Far Highlands: Water-cut gray ravines
scenes.facts: Water runs through the gray ravine between boulders and broad stone shelves. The cliffs hold dark damp streaks above scattered green terraces. Flowing water and a faint mineral smell fill the cooler air. The open channel gives a clear view along the hollow, while rock shoulders hide neighboring recesses. Loose fragments shift near the cliff foot; exposed shelves offer firmer footing above the shallows. Water noise softens conversation close to the channel, and louder words return as broken echoes.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Arathi Highlands: Windborne green-gold grasslands
scenes.facts: Green-gold grass runs over broad rises beneath the open sky. Isolated trees mark the slopes, casting small islands of shade far apart. The wind moves through the stems with a dry, continuous whisper and carries the scent of grass warmed between showers. Crests reveal long stretches of surrounding country; shallow folds conceal the lower ground. Old stones interrupt the turf in places, giving firmer seats and footing. Even quiet speech becomes difficult when the wind strengthens across the exposed rise.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Arathi Highlands: Gray-ribbed ridge country
scenes.facts: Gray stone rises through the grass in long, broken ribs. Loose fragments collect below the faces, and the turf thins where wind strikes the ridge directly. The broad country remains visible between the outcrops, though each stone shoulder hides a close hollow. Lichen gives the sheltered surfaces a pale, mottled skin. Boots ring on hard rock and scrape through gravel within the same few steps. Behind a larger outcrop, the wind drops enough for low voices to remain clear.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Hillsbrad Foothills: Pastoral green folds
scenes.facts: Green slopes rise and fall in broad, easy folds, their grasses dotted with flowers and interrupted by patches of cultivated soil. Pines mark the higher banks, and colder ridges stand faintly beyond them. The air smells of damp grass and earth. Open crests offer long views across the country; a shallow dip can hide a resting group almost completely. The ground is springy on the slopes, becoming softer wherever water has gathered along the foot of a field.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Hillsbrad Foothills: Fertile river meadows
scenes.facts: The river slips around a gravel bend, bright and restless beneath the open sky. Reeds and low branches edge quieter backwaters where the mud holds every footprint. The higher meadow is firm enough to sit on, with a clear view across the water and the slopes beyond. Running water softens nearby voices without drowning them. The air carries fresh grass and wet gravel; a sudden breeze brings cooler air along the channel before moving uphill through the pines.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Hillsbrad Foothills: Grassy southern seaboard
scenes.facts: The grass bends steadily toward the inland hills as sea wind crosses the low bluff. Below, sand and pebbles slope into blue-green water, where small waves keep up a loose, regular hiss. The beach leaves little concealment, while the grassy dips behind the edge offer shelter from both wind and distant eyes. Salt mingles with the smell of green growth. Words carry clearly along the bluff in one direction and disappear into the breeze in the other.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Dalaran lake country and lesser arcane quarters: Cool wooded lake-country rises
scenes.facts: The trees stand on cool, grassy rises above the lower country. Damp leaves collect around gray stones, and roots hold small terraces in the slope. The air smells of wet bark and pine resin. Openings reveal lighter sky and glimpses of the ground below, while the thicker trees conceal neighboring hollows. A sheltered pocket behind a root bank offers firm footing. Leaves stir softly overhead, and the slope carries a raised voice more clearly than the enclosed view suggests.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Alterac Mountains: Lower mountain pine woods
scenes.facts: The pines cling to a slope interrupted by gray rock and shelves of rough grass. Roots hold the damp ground in place, but loose stones shift where the tree cover thins. Cold air drifts upward from the valley, carrying the scent of resin. Uphill, trunks shut out the view; downhill, narrow openings reveal a long drop through blue mist. The slope offers small sheltered terraces, and conversation rises clearly between the rocks whenever the branches stop moving.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Alterac Mountains: Exposed gray high country
scenes.facts: Gray ridges rise around shelves of thin grass and loose, sharp stone. Wind crosses the exposed shoulders with a low whistle, then drops away abruptly behind an outcrop. The open ground makes movement visible at a distance, although each ridge conceals whatever lies beyond its crest. Footing changes from solid stone to sliding scree within a few steps. Protected cracks hold small pines and the faint smell of resin; elsewhere, the air is cold and bare.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Alterac Mountains: Upper snowfields and ice-crusted crags
scenes.facts: Snow fills the hollows between dark crags, blue in the shade and dazzling where the cloud thins. Wind lifts fine powder from the exposed shoulders and drives it against the ice-laden pines. Hard crust supports a step until a deeper drift gives way beneath it. The ridges offer wide views in clear air, then vanish behind blowing snow. A rock recess cuts the wind sharply, making breath and quiet speech audible against the distant hiss of the heights.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Gilneas: Rain-dark peninsula woods
scenes.facts: Moisture clings to dark leaves above the mossy floor. Pine trunks rise beside heavier branches over a floor of roots, brown litter and gray stone. The sheltered hollows smell of wet bark and rich earth. Mist obscures the lower ground, while higher rock gives a clearer view through the wood. Leaves soften footsteps until a hidden branch snaps. Beneath an overhanging shelf, the rustle of leaves becomes more distant and close speech is easier to hear.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Gilneas: Wind-washed gray-green moors
scenes.facts: Coarse grass and low heath spread beneath a low, restless sky. Gray stones emerge on the rises, while dark hollows hold water between the peat and roots. The wind carries a sharp smell of wet earth and presses the growth almost flat. Higher ground gives long views until mist moves across the next fold. Footing changes abruptly from firm stone to soft, yielding soil. A sheltered dip quiets the wind, though the damp there reaches through clothes quickly.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Gilneas: Storm-gray peninsula coast
scenes.facts: Gray cliffs meet dark water beneath a low ceiling of cloud. Waves strike the shelves below, spreading white foam across stone that shines black when wet. Tough grass holds the upper edge, with sheltered cracks offering relief from the salt wind. The open coast gives a long view between headlands, though the coves disappear behind each bend. Surf overwhelms softer words near the water. Higher recesses are quieter, but the air stays cold and damp against the skin.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Silverpine Forest: Silver-trunk forest depths
scenes.facts: Pale pine trunks rise in close ranks above a deep bed of needles. Low fog threads between them, gathering in hollows where moss covers the stones. The canopy moves far overhead; below it, the air is cool and remarkably still. Footsteps make a dry whisper on higher ground and a damp crunch nearer the hollow. A low rock shelf provides shelter from drizzle. Movement is easy to lose behind the repeated trunks, and voices travel farther than the narrow views suggest.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Silverpine Forest: Pine-clad maritime edge
scenes.facts: The pines grow almost to the edge, their outer branches pushed inland by the sea wind. Below the grass, wet rock descends into a narrow inlet where waves strike with a hollow boom. Salt spray reaches the exposed lip; sheltered cracks retain moss and cold pools. The coast opens long views along the water, though the forest closes quickly behind it. Surf swallows low speech near the rocks, and the smoother shelves become treacherous whenever a fresh wave washes across them.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Tirisfal Glades: Deep, misty greenwood
scenes.facts: The great trees hold the damp air beneath their branches. Moss softens the root banks, and old leaves yield quietly underfoot except where buried twigs crack. Gray mist pools in the hollows while higher ground remains clear enough to see between several rows of trunks. The woodland smells of wet bark and green growth. Broad roots offer dry places to pause, with enough cover to keep a conversation close even when voices carry through the still air.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Tirisfal Glades: Broad agrarian glades
scenes.facts: The glades unfold in green fields between dark wooded ridges. Low walls and hedges break the slopes into familiar parcels, some planted and others thick with pasture grass. Water beads on the taller stems; the open air carries earth, hay and distant birdsong. A figure on a rise is visible across several fields, while the hedge banks make quieter pockets below. Firm grassy crests alternate with damp hollows that pull at boots.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Western Weald: Living western weald woods
scenes.facts: Green branches overlap above the fertile woodland floor, where ferns surround old stones at the edge of the fields. The shade smells of leaf mold and damp bark; brighter openings carry the smell of grass. Roots and shallow hollows interrupt otherwise gentle ground. A voice can travel between the trunks, while the thick lower growth hides movement close by. Sunlit meadow edges offer a clear view outward, and the deeper wood provides cool shelter just a few steps away.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Western Weald: Broad grain-country fields
scenes.facts: The fields spread in broad strips over low rises, their grain moving in slow waves beside darker pasture. Stone boundaries and old trees mark the edges without breaking the long view. Warm soil, crushed grass and ripening stalks scent the air. The open rises reveal anyone moving through the neighboring parcels; taller growth hides the lower ground. Boundaries offer firmer footing than the cultivated earth, and wind through the grain makes a steady whisper around quiet conversation.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Eastweald: Living Eastweald forest
scenes.facts: The forest rises in wooded folds, with ferns gathered below broad roots and gray stones. Cool light reaches the ground through uneven gaps, revealing a higher ridge between distant trunks. The air smells of resin, damp leaves and freshly exposed earth. Nearer bushes interrupt sight at shoulder height; the higher shelves offer glimpses across the hollows. Firm roots alternate with soft leaf beds underfoot. Branches moving overhead keep a low rustle that softens voices without concealing a snapped twig.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Eastweald: Open Eastweald folds
scenes.facts: Meadow and field lie in uneven folds between darker wooded slopes. Gray stones break through the grass, and old boundaries disappear into thicker growth at the edges. The open crests give clear views into neighboring hollows, while a dip behind an outcrop can hide a resting group. Fresh grass and warm soil scent the air when the cloud clears. Wind moves freely over the rises, dropping to a quiet rustle wherever the trees reach down the slope.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Eastweald: Clean Eastweald water margins
scenes.facts: The water meets a bank of roots, reeds and gray stone beneath the wooded slope. Reflections darken the deeper stretches, while a gravel edge reveals the moving shallows. The open shelf gives a clear view over the water; the reed inlet beside it is sheltered by low branches. Damp wood and clean mud scent the air. Water sounds mask the softest words near the channel, and the muddy patches keep a sharp record of anyone stepping between the roots.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: The Hinterlands: Cliff-enclosed pine country
scenes.facts: Tall pines fill the country beneath immense reddish-gray cliffs. The valley floor is green and sheltered, with roots and boulders interrupting the grass. Resin hangs in the cool air while sunlight touches only scattered openings. The mountain walls return louder sounds as faint echoes, but closer speech stays among the trees. Dense trunks conceal the lower ground; a raised boulder gives a wider view into the next hollow. Firm grassy pockets alternate with damp fern beds in the deepest shade.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: The Hinterlands: High grassy rock shelves
scenes.facts: Grass grows across the high shelf until the ground breaks into reddish-gray stone and a steep drop. Pines cluster in deeper cracks, their branches moving steadily in the exposed wind. The view reaches over wooded ridges, leaving approaching movement easy to notice on neighboring heights. Rock-backed recesses offer a quieter place to stand. Underfoot, soft turf gives way abruptly to hard stone; near the edge, the breeze carries resin upward from the forest and scatters spoken words across the open air.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: The Hinterlands: Rugged eastern rockshore
scenes.facts: Forested heights descend into broken reddish-gray rock above the sea. Waves spread white water around the boulders, leaving lower shelves dark and slick. Higher grass offers dry footing and a broad view along the coast. The pines shelter inland pockets, but the exposed rim catches a steady salt wind. Surf fills the gaps between the rocks and muffles conversation near the water. Pebbles shift in the narrow coves, where a retreating wave leaves brief, quiet pools.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Tol Barad: Salt-wind moor
scenes.facts: Coarse grass bends under the sea wind across the low ground. Dark soil holds water in shallow hollows, and flatter stones provide firmer footing between them. The open land gives a long view until a small rise interrupts it. Wind carries sound away and brings the salt smell of the shore inland. A low rock bank offers partial shelter; moisture beads on exposed surfaces and gathers where the grass has been pressed down.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Tol Barad: Grey surf rocks
scenes.facts: Surf washes through the gaps between broad rock slabs. Shingle shifts underfoot on the lower beach, while the upper stone holds a firmer but uneven surface. The sea fills the soundscape, easing briefly between each wave. Low pools reflect the sky behind the outer ledges. Rock shoulders interrupt the shoreward view and shelter the ground nearest them; farther out, white water and mist soften the open horizon.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Channel Islands: Channel-island woodland
scenes.facts: Roots and rounded stones interrupt the soft leaf-covered ground. Tree crowns muffle the sea wind, leaving only a shifting rustle above the lower fern growth. Trunks divide the view into short distances; a gap reveals blue water and another wooded island beyond it. Damp bark and earth scent the sheltered air. Light moves across the open patches between the trees, while thicker brambles provide low cover along the irregular woodland edge.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Channel Islands: Grassy channel headland
scenes.facts: Grass and small flowers cover the rolling ground between the outcrops. The headland opens a long view across the channels, although each shallow fold hides the land immediately beyond its crest. Wind is stronger on the highest rise and quieter beside the low stone shoulders. The turf gives way to firmer bare ground around exposed rock. Sea air reaches the whole slope, carrying wave noise faintly beneath the steady movement of grass.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Channel Islands: Shingle between channels
scenes.facts: Small waves sort the sand and shingle along the water’s edge. The lower beach is firm where it remains wet, while loose stones move on the higher strip. Across the channel, wooded land is visible through the salt air. Shrubs and low rocks break the view inland. The upper bank offers drier ground, and water noise stays gentle enough for nearby sounds to carry between the open shore and the first trees.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Darkmoon Island: Violet crooked wood
scenes.facts: Crooked trunks and hanging branches keep the longer view short. Wet leaves cover an uneven mesh of roots, and low brambles fill many gaps near the ground. Mist settles between the trees, softening their edges beyond the nearest stand. Drops fall steadily from the canopy. The air smells of bark, mushrooms and damp earth; the thickest trunks block much of the wind, while rustling above them moves from one patch of leaves to the next.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Darkmoon Island: Dim island grass openings
scenes.facts: The grass opening leaves a wider view than the surrounding trees. Low rises still conceal shallow hollows, where wet earth shows beneath flattened stems. Pale weeds and grey stones catch what light reaches the ground. Wind crosses the centre more freely than the brambled edge. The tree line offers a sheltered boundary, with damp bark and foliage close by; farther across the opening, mist blurs the dark shapes of individual trunks.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Darkmoon Island: Purple-grey island coast
scenes.facts: Wet sand reflects a narrow strip of violet-grey light below the shingle. Water draws foam between the stones and leaves shells along the upper wash line. Driftwood and rock interrupt the otherwise open beach. The wooded bank limits the view inland, while haze softens the sea horizon. Surf is clearer here than sounds from among the trees. Drier ground lies above the latest wave marks, with the coarse stones giving it an uneven surface.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Zul'Dare: Dense maritime woodland
scenes.facts: The woodland closes around the uneven soil and mossy stones. Outer branches move in the sea wind, while the deeper stand stays quieter and more sheltered. Ferns and roots divide the ground beneath the trunks. A narrow gap gives a brief view of water before foliage fills the angle again. Leaves soften footfalls on the soil; bare rock carries sharper sounds, and damp bark and earth dominate the air within the trees.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Zul'Dare: Low rocky island grassland
scenes.facts: Low rises and broad stones interrupt the open grassland. The highest ground gives a long view toward the water, while the shallow saddles hide nearby hollows. Wind reaches the grass freely and fades at the woodland margin. Firm exposed rock alternates with softer soil around the shrub clumps. The trees create a distinct sheltered edge, and their shadows move across the closest open ground as the crowns bend above them.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Zul'Dare: Forest-backed island shore
scenes.facts: Sand fills the spaces between the coastal stones. Short waves wash the lower rock edges, leaving the upper bank drier beneath the trees. Roots and driftwood obstruct the landward fringe; the waterward view is open until distant haze softens it. Surf carries a steady sound across the beach. Shade under the wooded bank is cooler than the exposed sand, and the changing wash line separates firm wet ground from looser grains above it.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Isle of Quel’Danas: Coastal golden groves
scenes.facts: Golden crowns shade fresh green grass above the sea. Pale trunks stand far enough apart for cool reflected light to reach the roots, and salt air moves gently through the grove. The open spaces reveal the water and nearby movement; lower grassy pockets remain sheltered behind the roots. Firm turf makes comfortable resting ground. Leaves keep a light rustle above the softer sound of waves, and the air mixes clean salt with the scent of flowers and living growth.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Isle of Quel’Danas: Pale sand and turquoise shore
scenes.facts: Pale sand curves beneath a low grassy bank, with clear green-blue water washing around smooth stones. The shallows reveal shifting patterns of light before deepening farther out. The open beach offers little cover, while the higher grass provides a sheltered edge above the waves. Salt hangs cleanly in the air. Loose sand slows a step; firmer wet sand holds clear prints. The sea keeps a soft, regular hiss that grows louder wherever water reaches the stones.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Eversong Woods: Radiant golden woodland
scenes.facts: Golden leaves hold the light above pale, twisting trunks. Beneath them, fresh green plants and flowers fill the shade; the air is soft with living growth rather than the dry scent of autumn. Smooth roots divide patches of mossy ground, offering places to pause above the damp soil. Bright canopy openings reveal movement at a distance, while thicker trunks and bushes shelter closer conversation. Leaves stir gently overhead, scattering warm reflections across the cool green floor.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Eversong Woods: Spring-lit golden glades
scenes.facts: The canopy opens around a glade of fresh grass and low flowers. Golden crowns frame the sky, their shade broken by warm patches of light. The middle of the glade is easy to see from the surrounding wood, while the lower edge lies behind pale roots and leafy growth. Firm turf offers comfortable ground to stand or rest. A soft breeze carries floral scents across the opening; under the trees, leaf rustle makes quieter words less distinct.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Eversong Woods: Golden woodland sea margin
scenes.facts: Golden trees stand above a pale shore where clear water washes around smooth stones. Their roots hold a grassy bank just beyond the reach of the smaller waves. Shade beneath the crowns is cool, though the open sand catches warm light and leaves every movement exposed. Salt mingles with the scent of fresh leaves. The sea supplies a steady hush near the water, while farther beneath the trees, speech is clearer and the grass offers firmer ground.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Southern Eversong: Living southern golden woods
scenes.facts: Golden branches overlap above the uneven southern wood. Pale roots curl around mossy stones, and dense green growth fills the cooler hollows. Light reaches the ground in narrow, warm patches, leaving neighboring trunks in blue-green shade. The air smells of wet leaves and living bark. Higher root shelves offer firmer footing and a view across nearby dips, while the thicker growth hides the lower slopes. Leaf rustle softens close conversation, and the enclosed trees keep the breeze gentle.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Southern Eversong: Green southern woodland banks
scenes.facts: Clean water moves beneath pale roots and over shallow stones. Reeds gather where the bank bends inward, their green stems reflected below the golden branches. Damp moss gives way to firmer rock shelves and softer muddy inlets. The water carries nearby sounds along the bank, while the rising woodland closes the view inland. Fresh leaves and wet stone scent the shade. A low grassy shelf sits above the waterline, sheltered from wind by the roots and thicker growth.

scenes.label: Zul’Aman and Amani forestlands: Immense shadowed pine forest
scenes.facts: Immense trunks hold their crowns high above the ferny ground. Roots run across the damp soil and around gray stones, some of which retain worn carved edges beneath the moss. The shade smells of resin and wet vegetation. Thick growth hides the lower hollows, while the open pocket between two trees gives a clearer view uphill. Footsteps sink quietly into the leaf bed except at the roots. A raised voice returns faintly from the stony slopes beyond the nearest trunks.

scenes.label: Zul’Aman and Amani forestlands: Wooded ridge shoulders
scenes.facts: The ridge opens above the denser trees, with grass and bare stone between widely spaced pines. Wooded folds stretch away below it, and the exposed shoulder catches a cooler breeze. The higher ground offers clear views toward neighboring slopes, while roots and rock conceal the nearest hollows. Loose stones scrape under boots beside firmer shelves. Resin reaches the open air from the forest edge; behind a larger outcrop, branch rustle becomes louder than the wind and voices remain close.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Tiragarde Sound: Sound-country pine woods
scenes.facts: Pine needles soften the ground between the large rounded stones. Ferns and purple flowers fill the brighter gaps, while the thicker trunks keep nearby spaces shaded. Wind moves high in the crowns and reaches the forest floor only in short gusts. The rocks conceal ground behind their shoulders and offer sheltered edges beneath the trees. Damp moss and resin scent the air, with the distant sea rarely visible beyond the repeated wooded slopes.

scenes.label: Tiragarde Sound: Grey Sound crag country
scenes.facts: The upland alternates between bare rock and narrow grassy shelves. The open side gives a long view across wooded slopes toward the Sound. Cloud catches on the higher crags, and the air feels cooler than below. Wind is strongest around the exposed edges, quieter behind the larger stone shoulders. Loose fragments gather in hollows between firmer surfaces; scattered conifers cast small shadows and break the sound of the wind near their roots.

scenes.label: Tiragarde Sound: Rounded-rock Sound shore
scenes.facts: The shore’s large rounded rocks divide the beach into smaller pockets. Water laps against their dark bases, and coarse sand fills the spaces that remain above the wash. Purple flowers and conifer roots occupy the green upper bank. The Sound opens a long waterward view, while the boulders conceal the ground immediately behind them. Wave noise stays close and repetitive; sheltered gaps offer quieter air and a firmer place to stand above the tide.

scenes.label: Drustvar: Russet knotted forest
scenes.facts: Wet russet leaves cover the uneven ground between immense roots. The canopy holds the lower forest in cool shade, with mist lying close to the stones. Trunks shorten the view in every direction, and pale mushrooms show where light reaches the damp soil. Dripping branches and shifting leaves make the quiet intermittent. Thick roots form sheltered recesses, while exposed stone interrupts the softer leaf cover and gives a clearer sound beneath a step.

scenes.label: Drustvar: Cold mountain rock slopes
scenes.facts: Bare stone and loose scree dominate the slope. Thin grass holds in the deeper cracks, and stunted trees mark the sheltered pockets below the larger shoulders. The view reaches over red woodland toward cloud-softened mountains. Wind moves sharply around exposed corners and quiets inside the clefts. Firm slabs alternate with smaller shifting fragments. The air is cold and dry against the face, while moisture darkens shaded rock where cloud has touched the mountainside.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Stormsong Valley: Flowering green valley
scenes.facts: Flowers and tall grass cover the rolling ground around smooth grey stones. The open slopes give long views until another fold rises across them. Air moving through the meadow carries the scent of warm greenery, and insects add a fine sound beneath the wind. The stones provide solid edges beside the softer turf. Sheltered hollows hold a little more moisture and shade, while higher ground catches the light and the full breeze from the coast.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Stormsong Valley: Clear valley water margin
scenes.facts: Clear water moves around the rounded stones and widens into quieter pools. Pale gravel is visible below the shallow edge. The banks alternate between soft grass, wet soil and firmer stone shelves. Trees shade one side, shortening the view beneath their crowns; the opposite bank is more open. Running water carries a steady sound and cools the nearby air. Flowering growth leans over the margins, with small ripples marking every change in the streambed.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Stormsong Valley: Windy tidal bluffs
scenes.facts: Grass grows thickly above the tidal stone, then thins at the exposed bluff edges. Wind reaches the upper ground without much interruption and carries the smell of salt inland. Below, water washes the lower shelves in repeated white seams. The rock folds limit the nearby view even where the horizon is broad. Higher turf is drier than the dark surfaces beside the wash, and wave sounds rise clearly whenever the wind eases.

scenes.label: Mechagon: Remnant island conifers
scenes.facts: Needles gather around the conifer roots and pale rock slabs. Grass grows more thickly in the hollows where the thin soil holds moisture. Trunks shorten the view, though gaps show dusty ridges outside the stand. Wind moves through the uneven crowns and drops into the open spaces between them. Resin and damp earth scent the shaded ground. Larger roots and stones provide firm edges among softer patches of soil and sparse undergrowth.

scenes.label: Mechagon: Weathered grey island uplands
scenes.facts: Thin grass grows between broad slabs and dusty soil. The open ground gives a long view across the low ridges, with the sea appearing beyond the lower gaps. Wind carries a dry mineral smell across the exposed slopes. Larger stone shoulders hide the ground immediately behind them and offer quieter air. Firm rock alternates with loose grit underfoot; scattered conifers mark the hollows where deeper soil collects and the surface holds a little more moisture.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Mechagon: Gravelly island waterline
scenes.facts: Gravel shifts on the upper shore, while broad wet shelves form a firmer surface below it. Water gathers in shallow pools behind the outer rock edges. The sea opens the longer view, and the sparse trees give only small areas of shade. Salt air moves freely across the beach. Waves have a short, repetitive sound against the low stone; the latest wash marks show where the drier ground gives way to the changing waterline.

scenes.label: Ashenvale: Emerald forest beneath ancient trunks
scenes.facts: Ancient trunks hold the canopy far overhead, while purple growth crowds the spaces between their broad roots. Damp leaves soften footsteps on the earthy hollow; farther in, fern beds and mossy boulders interrupt easy footing. A conversation beneath the roots is screened from several directions, although voices can travel through the open gaps between trunks. Cool green light reveals nearby faces more clearly than the layered forest beyond. Branches stir high above the sheltered ground.

scenes.label: Ashenvale: Blue-green woodland water margin
scenes.facts: Clear water opens a long view beneath the towering woodland. Pebbles remain visible in the shallows, while reeds and roots divide the bank into wet patches and firmer shelves. Water sounds soften nearby speech, but a voice directed across the open surface carries farther. The purple thickets provide screened places above the damp edge. Bags can rest on dry earth beside the mossy stones; approaching along the bank requires choosing footing between roots, reeds and water.

scenes.label: Moonglade: Teal woodland of the sheltered basin
scenes.facts: Soft teal light settles among the old trunks and thick fern beds. The basin's slopes appear briefly through gaps in the trees, enclosing even the distant view. Moss cushions the stones, while roots break the damp floor into small patches of firmer earth. Branch movement is quieter below the dense canopy, leaving a nearby voice or a footstep distinct. The overlapping trunks provide cover around an open patch where belongings can be laid down without entering the deepest growth.

scenes.label: Darkshore: Grey pebble coast and kelp line
scenes.facts: Surf turns the lower pebbles dark and leaves kelp along the wet margin. The upper beach is firmer, though scattered boulders and tangled roots divide its available space. The open shore gives a long view of approaching movement; the evergreens shelter pockets just above the tide line. Sea noise competes with conversation near the water, while speech is clearer behind the rocks. Salt and damp wood scent the narrow ground between the coast and the wooded slopes.

scenes.label: Darkshore: Sea-facing evergreen woodland
scenes.facts: Damp needles soften the forest floor around dark stones and broad roots. The trees shelter the inland hollows from much of the coastal wind, though surf remains audible through the branches. A gap gives a brief grey glimpse of the sea. Nearby trunks screen a conversation from the upper bank, while low bracken conceals uneven footing rather than offering clear space. The larger earthy patches allow bags to rest above the wet hollows, close to the scent of moss and salt.

scenes.label: Darkshore: Reeded river mouth and wet bank
scenes.facts: The river spreads into shallow channels between reeds and gravel tongues. Soft mud holds some edges while roots and stones support the higher bank. Water movement and surf mingle here, making a conversation beside the channel less distinct from farther away. The open mouth exposes arrivals across the shallows; reeds screen the lower ground from inland sight. A dry rise provides room to pause, but approaching it means choosing between firmer gravel and the darker, softer silt.

scenes.label: Pinkwood: Living Pinkwood high canopy
scenes.facts: The old canopy shades a floor of damp leaves, ferns and violet growth. The land rises between broad roots and mossy stones, breaking easy passage into irregular patches of firm earth. Thick growth screens the lower hollows while a nearby voice remains clear beneath the branches. Cool light catches the younger saplings where the canopy opens. A broad root shelf offers room to halt and place belongings above the wetter ground, within the smell of living wood and leaf mould.

scenes.label: Pinkwood: Clear mountain-forest water margin
scenes.facts: Clear water gathers between grey stones before spilling into the narrower stream below. Its sound softens speech along the bank, while the wider pool leaves anyone on the opposite edge visible between the trunks. Roots and moss make the immediate footing uneven. Dry shelves sit above the splashing water and offer room for a pause with belongings. Ferns shelter the inland side; the smell of wet stone and living bark fills the cool space beneath the canopy.

scenes.label: Pinkwood: Wooded mountain ravines
scenes.facts: Grey stone shelves interrupt steep ground beneath the forest. Roots grip the higher banks, while moss and thick ferns occupy the sheltered clefts. A voice can echo briefly between rock faces, then fade behind the next wooded shoulder. The open shelf gives a small group firm footing and a view across part of the ravine. Its edges fall into looser soil and dense growth, so movement between the upper and lower ground remains slower than the distance first suggests.

scenes.label: Azshara: Copper and crimson autumn woodland
scenes.facts: Copper leaves filter warm light onto golden grass and pale rocks. Dry fallen foliage rustles underfoot, making nearby movement audible even where the red shrubs screen it. The spaced trunks offer intermittent views through the woodland rather than one clear approach. A gnarled root and low stone bank shelter a patch for setting down belongings or speaking together. Cooler air reaches the trees from the coast, shifting the high leaves while the hollow beneath them remains more protected.

scenes.label: Azshara: Golden coastal heights
scenes.facts: Golden grass moves over the high ground above the sea. The broad view makes a figure crossing the open slope visible from far away, while red tree groups and rocky hollows interrupt the inland sightline. Wind is strongest near the cliff rim; farther back, the low folds offer quieter footing and shelter. Pale stones sit among the seed heads, leaving firm places to pause with belongings. The open water below carries the color and sound of the coast into the conversation.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Azshara: Blue cove beneath autumn cliffs
scenes.facts: Blue water enters between the cove's rock arms and spreads over pale sand. Small pools remain among the textured stones, with seaweed marking the wetter edge. The dry pocket above the tide gives room to pause beneath the autumn-clad heights. Cliffs shorten the view inland and reflect the surf's sound, while the water entrance remains open to sight. Footing changes sharply between firm sand and wet rock, and the available shore narrows as the water reaches farther in.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Mount Hyjal: Ancient mountain conifer forest
scenes.facts: Needled branches shelter the steep ground beneath immense conifers. Ferns gather in the moister hollows, while roots and grey outcrops leave small firmer shelves across the slope. Pine scent reaches the open patches when the wind moves overhead. Trees screen the lower approach; gaps reveal distant mountain forest across the valley. A conversation below the hanging boughs is sheltered from much of the wind, though crossing between shelves requires negotiating the roots and uneven stone.

scenes.label: Winterspring: Lavender snow beneath firs
scenes.facts: Snow weighs down the fir branches and fills the hollows beside their roots. The ground looks smooth until a drift reveals the buried stone beneath it. Trees shorten the view and shelter much of the woodland from the wind. Nearby speech is clear in the cold air, while soft snow absorbs footfalls between the trunks. A wider gap offers room to halt, though setting down belongings means choosing the firmer surface beside a boulder rather than the deepest powder.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Winterspring: Open white valley and pale rock
scenes.facts: The white valley opens a long view between distant fir stands and pale slopes. A dark figure crossing the snow is conspicuous against the broad drifts. Wind reaches the open ground, while boulders shelter smaller hollows where speech and a pause are more comfortable. Smooth snow hides uneven depth around the rocks; exposed stone offers firmer footing. The cold air feels sharper away from the trees, and moving across the valley leaves a visible line behind it.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Kalidar: Island forest beneath pale trunks
scenes.facts: Pale trunks enclose a patch of firm island earth above damp root hollows. Violet growth and ferns screen the outer ground, while a gap in the canopy admits cooler light from the coast. Salt air mingles with moss and leaf mould beneath the branches. A conversation can remain sheltered among the roots, though the denser growth shortens the view of anyone approaching. The open earthy patch gives room to pause with belongings before the surrounding woodland closes again.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Kalidar: Rocky island inlet and forest edge
scenes.facts: The inlet narrows the open sea between dark rock arms. Grey sand holds the sheltered upper shore, while wet ledges and kelp mark the changing waterline. The entrance remains visible across the cool water; roots and thick foliage screen the inland bank. Surf sounds soften conversation nearer the outer rocks, and the sheltered sand offers quieter space to pause. Footing changes between loose stones, firm wet sand and dry ground beneath the trees, all within the reach of salt air.
scenes.purpose: A recurring regional meeting place. Its physical affordances leave individual conduct to the participants.

scenes.label: Durotar: Red sandstone recesses
scenes.facts: Orange rock holds the heat above a floor of cracked red earth. Thorn scrub grows between loose stones, and a shaded hollow offers firmer ground away from the brightest glare. The surrounding shoulders break the view into short stretches; movement around a bend can be heard before its source appears. Voices rebound close to the rock, while the open mouth exposes an exchange to anyone on the adjoining ground. Fine dust gathers in the sheltered edges.
